body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> SBNTehc(www.sbn-tech,com) introduced All-in-one embedded Video Phone 'MPAD' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
10.1-inch pad type 'MPAD' offers video phone functionality basically. Also it supports multimedia player and web browser functionality together with Android platform.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
